metadata_lineage_note.instruction: Preserve Night-9C provenance metadata, but do not use E18.5 data in Night-10A.

objective: Develop and audit Quality-Calibrated Cross-modal Residual Denoising (QCRD) on frozen authoritative representations, with no dataset-name routing and no new external benchmark.
development_status: A1, tonsil, D1 and P22 are development evidence, not pristine holdouts.

forbidden_actions: Retrain an old baseline only to backfill metrics
Use labels in training, loss, early stopping, epoch selection, seed selection or cluster-endpoint selection
Build dense N-by-N distance, adjacency or spatial-kernel matrices
allowed_family_preprocessing: RNA+protein family preprocessing shared by A1, tonsil and D1
RNA+ATAC family preprocessing shared by P22 and future RNA+ATAC data

datasets.reference: F00_R02 or its authoritative Night-7B equivalent for the exact registered seed

frozen_inputs.policy: Reuse existing authoritative views, partitions, affinities and checkpoints; hash before and after. Do not retrain to create missing metric inputs.

implementation_constraints: Same trainable architecture for RNA+protein and RNA+ATAC
Family-dependent preprocessing is allowed; dataset-dependent trainable weights are not

candidates.mechanism: No QCRD correction; exact authoritative family reference.
Frozen global quality chooses a soft teacher and a bounded global residual gate.
Frozen per-spot reliability gates a small conditional residual adapter.
Unilateral masked residual reconstruction of the lower-confidence modality conditioned on the teacher.
Q02 plus masked conditional residual denoising.
Q04 with a fixed boundary-risk suppressor that reduces correction at local discontinuities.
Q04 with low-dimensional Fourier coordinate features; no dense spatial kernel.
Q04 with sparse reciprocal-MNN positives weighted by frozen confidence; no dense pairwise distance matrix.

stage_r1.selection: Rank after all registered outputs are locked. Preserve at most one accuracy, one balanced and one spatial frontier, deduplicated to at most three candidates. A mild loss on one dataset is a ranking penalty, not an automatic invalidation.

stage_r2.entry_condition: At least one real candidate is finite, semantically valid and improves either a modality-family mean Q or a registered frontier score without catastrophic spatial collapse.
stage_r2.stop_condition: If no candidate is semantically valid or all candidates show catastrophic spatial collapse, stop after R1 and report the negative result.

reporting: Mean, median, standard deviation and worst seed
Paired deltas against the exact same-seed reference
Exact paired sign-flip p-value when sample size permits

ranking_frontiers.accuracy: Mean paired Q with ARI and NMI shown separately; extended metrics are secondary tie-breakers.
ranking_frontiers.balanced: Worst-dataset and worst-family paired Q, followed by macro paired Q.
ranking_frontiers.spatial: Accuracy gain with no material deterioration across the four registered spatial metrics.

hard_invalidity_only: Ground-truth leakage into training or selection
Wrong dataset, modality, spot order, seed, reference or config SHA
Implementation does not match the registered candidate semantics

operational_limits.rule: Do not silently wait on one CPU transform for hours. Record TIMEOUT and continue independent registered units; stop cleanly at the wall-clock limit.
